Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1005
Claimant:
Kristy Wood
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
May 21, 2024
Calim opened following a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a
traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
June 2, 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in focre at the time of loss. Police report
obtained and reviewed.
June 8, 2024
Statements from the other driver, two independent witnesses, and scene photographs all agree on how the collision
occurred. The vehicle was in the claimant's lane and was struck at moderate speed by the trailing vehicle.
July 18, 2024
Police and both witnesses confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. No conflicting
information has been received on this point.
August 13, 2024
Medical records received from the claimant's treating providers document a concussion. The reported symptoms and
the force of the impact are consistent with one another. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the file or
from the claimant's history given so far.
August 29, 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested updated records and a
treatment timeline from counsel to understand the reasons for the extended care.
September 23, 2024
Claimant has added some smaller details to the account since the first interview, but the core description of events
has not changed. Repair estimate reviewed; it is not yet clear whether all listed damage resulted from this impact, so
the vehicle has been referred for a closer inspection.
October 13, 2024
A neighbor has told the field representative that the vehicle appeared damaged a few weeks before the claimed loss
date. This has not been verified and is being noted for follow-up. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in the
file at this time, and the claim remains under review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
